start.text: Hey, welcome to the tour prototype! I'm a placeholder NPC — everything you see here gets replaced by a photorealistic scan of the CORE building. Want to know how this all works?

how.text: You walked over to me and pressed E — that's the whole interaction model. I'm defined in zones.json with a position and a radius, and my lines live in a JSON file anyone on the team can edit without touching code.

splat.text: This gray box room is a stand-in built from the collision walls. Once the team trains a Gaussian splat of the real CORE first floor, that file drops into public/splats/, one line changes in zones.json, and you'll be walking through a photoreal scan instead.

bye.text: See you around! Try walking into the walls — you'll slide along them instead of passing through. That's the collision system doing its job.
